### The Sound of Dropping Rocks
Author: Sharon Jaynes
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement/encouragement-for-today-february-3-2022.html
Passage: John 8:7
Points:
- The Pharisees sought to condemn a caught woman and trap Jesus, but He exposed their own guilt.
- The only person fully qualified to cast a stone at her was the One who chose to set her free.
- Believers easily throw stones through judgmental thoughts, gossip, and self-righteous superiority.
- Past failures do not define a believer's story because God meets confession with divine grace.
- Experiencing God's mercy calls us to lay down our stones and extend forgiveness to others.

### The Two Voices
Author: Linda Gray
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/encouragement-cafe/the-two-voices-encouragement-cafe-september-4.html
Passage: John 8:10-11
Points:
- Jesus silenced the woman's accusers by confronting them with their own sinfulness until all walked away.
- Voices that bring shame, fear, and condemnation stem from the devil rather than the Savior.
- Jesus speaks with firm truth and loving kindness, refusing to condemn those who turn to Him.
- Christ completely forgives and forgets our past sins while directing us to sin no more.
- Believers must choose daily to tune out condemnation and trust the voice of Christ.
